SHapley Additive exPlanations. A game-theoretic method that calculates the contribution of each feature to a model prediction.

# Global Context Pack: PFOA Removal by Electrochemical Oxidation

## 1. Scope
This document evaluates the removal of perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) from water through electrochemical oxidation.
PFOA is a persistent and toxic pollutant with strong carbon-fluorine bonds.
The electrochemical treatment involves complex nonlinear interactions among multiple operating parameters.
This study develops a machine learning framework that couples Fast Lightweight AutoML (FLAML) with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP).
The framework automates model selection, tunes hyperparameters in time budgets, and explains predictive mechanisms.

## 2. Core Thesis
Automated machine learning with FLAML optimizes XGBoost to predict PFOA removal accurately.
SHAP analysis reveals the primary operational drivers of electrochemical oxidation.

## 3. Key Concepts and Methodology
Fast Lightweight AutoML (FLAML) finds optimal learners and hyperparameters in tight time budgets.
Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) serves as the top-performing regressor selected by FLAML.
The evaluation compares FLAML XGBoost against five baseline regressors across ten repeated stratified splits.
SHAP quantifies feature importance and multi-parameter interactions.
The author validated grouped TreeSHAP rankings against conditional permutation importance to account for collinear predictors.

## 4. Primary Findings
FLAML-optimized XGBoost achieved an RMSE of 3.97 and an R-squared of 0.98.
This model outperformed all baseline models with statistical significance (p < 1e-5).
FLAML completed optimization in 300 seconds and reduced tuning time by 72 percent compared to grid searches.

Electrolysis duration and anode material emerged as the primary operational drivers of PFOA mineralization.
Electrolyte concentration and current density formed the second importance tier.
This matches the theory of electrochemical kinetics.
The research team encapsulated the entire pipeline in Docker to guarantee independent verification.
